name: 4-thiomescaline
summary: 4-Thiomescaline (4-TM), or simply thiomescaline, also known as 3,5-dimethoxy-4-methylthiophenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline (3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine). It is the analogue of mescaline in which the methoxy group at the 4 position has been replaced with a methylthio group.

pharmacology.text: It was described as being more similar in its effects to LSD than to mescaline and as being similar in effects to the Aleph series.

uses.en: It was described by Alexander Shulgin in his book PiHKAL and has rarely been used outside that work.
uses.zh: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述過它，除此之外很少有人使用。
uses.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在著作《PiHKAL》中描述过它，除此之外很少有人使用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Replacing a single oxygen atom of mescaline with sulphur makes 4-thiomescaline several times more potent, and it was described as being more like LSD than mescaline in its effects.
fact.zh: 只把麥司卡林的一個氧原子換成硫，就讓4-硫代麥司卡林的效力強上好幾倍，而且據描述它的作用比較像LSD而不像麥司卡林。
fact.zhHans: 只把麦司卡林的一个氧原子换成硫，就让4-硫代麦司卡林的效力强上好几倍，而且据描述它的作用比较像LSD而不像麦司卡林。
